title: Outcome of Descemet membrane endothelial keratoplasty for graft failure after Descemet stripping automated endothelial keratoplasty

indication: Corneal decompensation with insufficient optical quality after previous successful DSAEK (graft failure); original DSAEK indications Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy 12, pseudophakic bullous keratopathy 1, unknown 2; repeat DSAEK before DMEK in 5 of 15 patients; interval from the latest DSAEK 6 to 31 months; primary graft failure after DSAEK and insufficient postoperative data excluded

groups.description: Secondary DMEK after explantation of the failed DSAEK graft, single surgeon, Goethe-University Frankfurt, November 2014 to March 2016: graft mobilized and explanted via a 2.2-mm incision, remaining recipient Descemet membrane removed within 9.0 mm, trypan-blue stained organ-cultured DMEK grafts (7.75 or 8.0 mm), 20% SF6 tamponade (80-90% fill), supine positioning 2-3 days; retrospective case series

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT before DMEK (Table 3 row 'Preoperative'), measured with the failed DSAEK graft still in place; Pentacam AXL (Methods)
series.notes: Table 3 rows Preoperative and Post DMEK 1, 3 and 12 months; mean ± SD in µm; CCT by Pentacam AXL Scheimpflug tomography; per-visit n not reported

exclusions.what: Table 2 (CDVA after DSAEK and DMEK) and Table 4 (ECD)

exclusions.reason: Donor tissue data, not the patients' corneal thickness

exclusions.what: Histopathologic thickness of the explanted DSAEK grafts (Results)
exclusions.reason: Ex vivo graft-only measurement, not in vivo CCT

notes: Role: standard DMEK technique without an investigational agent; single control-role group.

Retrospective case series of 15 eyes of 15 patients; rebubbling in 3 eyes (1, 2 and 4 weeks after surgery); one patient required regrafting for primary graft failure 6 months after DMEK. Whether that eye contributes to the 12-month mean is not stated.
Table 3 has no 6-month CCT row although CDVA was also recorded at 6 months (Table 2).
The reference is the CCT before DMEK, i.e. the edematous cornea with the failed DSAEK lenticule in place.
Statistics used the Wilcoxon test; Table 3 reports mean ± SD.
